column1: # Data for figure spontaneous_sync_traces_old_vs_new_SP.jpeg (time evolution during synchronization).
# in each variant's raw data folder.
# One row per saved row of the raw file: row_index 0 is the end of the relaxation phase (t = 0)
# one row every 10 simulated minutes; time_h = row_index * 10 / 60.
# Measure columns (raw file column in brackets): odpr_1 [0] = order parameter of population 1
# fi_mean_1 [1] = mean firing rate of population 1 (Hz)
# variant: Original / Original1 = original SP model
# r_hom_over_r_hebb = ratio of homeostatic to Hebbian SP rates.
